name: Compress Images
tagline: Smaller photos with no visible loss, one or a whole batch. Nothing is uploaded.
seoTitle: Compress images without uploading (JPG, PNG, WebP)
description: Make JPG, PNG and WebP images smaller for free in your browser, one or many at once. Choose the quality. Photos never leave your device.

specs.PNG: Converted to WebP (keeps transparency) unless you choose otherwise

faq.a: No. They're re-encoded inside this tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.

faq.q: Why did one image not get smaller?
faq.a: Some images are already well compressed. If the new file isn't smaller, the tool tells you and you can keep the original.

faq.q: Does it remove location data too?
faq.a: Yes, re-encoded images don't carry the original EXIF metadata. For lossless removal without re-encoding, use Remove Photo Location.
